title: Notifications
description:
Building on the initial dive into Collision, this is a follow up exploring an implementation of the instrument. Various notification sounds were created for a cell phone scenario, accomplished with Collision, Operator, and Simpler. 

In addition to further working with Collision, this was also a dive into understanding how we perceive certain sounds and what we have socially assoaicated them with. An emergency siren going off doesn't get perceived as 'Oh I got a calendar reminder'.

audio.label: Calendar
audio.desc: A calendar notification. For me, usually a reminder for a birthday or bills.

audio.label: Emergency
audio.desc: A siren warning meant for your immediate attention. Usually an AMBER alert in my case, but I remember getting one in Taiwan when they were testing their inbound missile strike alert.

audio.label: Error
audio.desc: An error or invalid input notification.

audio.label: Ringtone
audio.desc: The standard ringtone you hear in your dreams or a movie. A bit more common with landlines now that I think about it...

audio.label: Timer
audio.desc: A timer going off. Usually notifying me that my laundry or food in the oven is ready.

audio.label: Wake Up Alarm
audio.desc: A gentle piano alarm. A low pass filter slowly opens up to make it a bit brighter without violently waking up the listener.
